title: GoCell Slice Descriptor
description: Defines a Slice, the implementation mapping unit within a Cell. A Slice is the sole write-side for dependency truth via contractUsages.

id.description: Unique slice identifier. Must equal the directory name under cells/{cell-id}/slices/. Must match the shared IdentifierPattern (^[a-z][a-z0-9]{1,31}$): lowercase letters and digits only, 2-32 chars, no dashes / underscores / dots. Aligned with AssemblyID / CellID for single-source typed scaffold identifier funnel (pkg/scaffoldid).

belongsToCell.description: The parent cell id. This is a derived-anchor and may be omitted when it can be inferred from the directory path.

lifecycle.description: Governance maturity phase of the slice. Optional; empty defaults to experimental at runtime (kernel/cellvocab.CellLifecycle). MUST be ≤ the parent cell's lifecycle (governance rule CELL-LIFECYCLE-01).

contractUsages.description: Contracts this slice depends on, with the role it plays for each.

contract.description: Contract id referenced by this slice.

role.description: The role this slice plays in the contract.

handler.description: Consumer handler method name on the slice's service struct. REQUIRED for role=subscribe and role=webhook-receive, forbidden otherwise.

group.description: Broker consumer group for role=subscribe. Optional; defaults to the owning cell ID when empty. Forbidden for non-subscribe roles.

field.description: Cell-struct field name holding the consumer; disambiguates slices that own more than one *sliceID.T field. Optional for role=subscribe, role=webhook-receive, role=webhook-dispatch (cellgen resolves by package convention when empty); forbidden for all other roles.

sourceID.description: Secret-isolation key identifying the webhook source. REQUIRED for role=webhook-receive and role=webhook-dispatch; forbidden for all other roles. Must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$ (aligns with runtime kernel/webhook sourceIDPattern).

targetSelector.description: Target-URL selector method name for outbound webhook dispatch. REQUIRED for role=webhook-dispatch; forbidden for all other roles.

projection.description: ProjectionID marking this subscribe CU as feeding an L3 CQRS projection. Makes cellgen emit reg.RegisterProjection instead of reg.Subscribe. snake_case probe-name format. Optional; forbidden on every non-subscribe role.

onReset.description: Exported Go identifier naming the optional rebuild Reset-phase hook method on the slice service (cell.ProjectionResetHook). Only meaningful when projection is set. Optional; subscribe-only. Forbidden when projectionSource is saga-journal (no rebuild on that path).

projectionSource.description: Input stream selector for a projection subscribe CU. 'outbox' consumes the named event contract's topic (contract.kind=event); 'saga-journal' consumes the global saga journal (contract.kind=saga, stream saga.journal.v1) and makes cellgen emit cell.NewSagaJournalProjectionRequest. REQUIRED when projection is set; subscribe-only.

verify.description: Verification targets for this slice. Every contractUsage must have a matching verify.contract entry or a waiver.

contract.description: Contract test identifiers. Each contractUsage must have a corresponding entry here or in waivers.

waivers.description: Temporary waivers for contractUsages that lack a verify.contract entry. Expired waivers are treated as missing.

owner.description: Person or team who approved this waiver.

expiresAt.description: Expiration date (YYYY-MM-DD). After this date the waiver is invalid.

allowedFiles.description: Optional whitelist of files allowed in this slice directory. Enforced by FMT-17.

consistencyLevel.description: Required: L0|L1|L2|L3|L4. slice.yaml is the SoR for slice consistency level (codegen funnel projects into slice_gen.go.sliceMeta). MUST be ≤ cell.consistencyLevel.
